exact_mirror_checks.proof_scope: Integer group identities, affine mirrors and dual norm checks. The notes supply the analytic eigenfunction proof.

L_triomino.proof_scope: Refinement-stable numerical gap counts. Endpoint clusters use the known constructed multiplicities and mass-inner-product projections onto explicit eigenfunctions. No certified continuum count, completeness of the arithmetic subset, or proof that another eigenvalue is non-algebraic.

Turtle_low_modes.proof_scope: Twelve conforming FEM estimates, not certified continuum enclosures.
